headlines.title: 华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年9月29日
headlines.summary: 美伊会谈僵局打压美股、推升原油，原油盘中涨超5%，报道称特朗普放松制裁消息后一度“闪跌”；10年期美债收益率再创2007年来新高；金银重挫，黄金盘中跌超4%。 报道：伊朗预计美国中期选举后双方冲突升级的可能性很高。 特朗普否认曾向伊朗提出放松制裁或解冻资金。 两周前因遭袭而关闭的沙特关键输油管道恢复出口，报道称已恢复一半运力。 中国国常会：要加大宏观政策逆周期调节力度，研究出台稳定房地产市场、促进就业增收等政策措施。 中国央行等八部门推出19项金融举措支持服务业扩能提质，提出引导金融机构综合运用信贷、债券、股权等多样化工具，支持“人工智能+软件”发展。

headlines.title_en: Wallstreetcn Breakfast | September 29, 2026
headlines.summary_en: US-Iran talks deadlock weighs on US stocks and drives oil higher, with crude up over 5% intraday before briefly plunging after reports that Trump eased sanctions; 10-year US Treasury yield hits another high since 2007; gold and silver tumble, with gold down over 4% intraday. Report: Iran expects a high probability of escalated conflict between the two sides after the US midterm elections. Trump denies having offered Iran sanctions relief or frozen-funds unfreezing. Saudi Arabia's key oil pipeline, shut two weeks ago after an attack, resumes exports, with reports saying half of capacity has been restored. China's State Council executive meeting: it is necessary to step up countercyclical adjustment of macro policies, and study and introduce policy measures to stabilize the real estate market and promote employment and income growth. China's PBOC and seven other departments roll out 19 financial measures to support the expansion and upgrading of the service sector, proposing to guide financial institutions to comprehensively use diversified tools such as credit, bonds and equity to support the development of 'AI plus software'.

headlines.title: 央行：二季度末服务业中长期贷款余额达76.22万亿元
headlines.summary: 9月29日，国家发展改革委召开专题新闻发布会介绍推进服务业扩能提质有关情况。中国人民银行信贷市场司副司长车士义表示，近年来，为推动服务业加快发展，支持各类新兴业态、新服务场景融资，人民银行会同相关部门出台了一系列政策举措，着力完善金融产品和服务，促进加大高质量服务供给。截至今年二季度末，全国本外币服务业中长期贷款余额76.22万亿元，同比增长6.4%，增速比各项贷款高1.3个百分点，金融支持服务业发展取得明显成效。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Outstanding medium- and long-term loans to the service industry reached 76.22 trillion yuan at the end of Q2
headlines.summary_en: On September 29, the National Development and Reform Commission held a special press conference to brief on progress in promoting the expansion and upgrading of the service sector. Che Shiyi, deputy director of the PBOC's Credit Market Department, said that in recent years, to promote accelerated development of the service sector and support financing for various new business forms and new service scenarios, the PBOC, together with relevant departments, has introduced a series of policy measures, focusing on improving financial products and services and promoting an increase in high-quality service supply. As of the end of the second quarter this year, the outstanding medium- and long-term loans in domestic and foreign currencies to the service sector nationwide stood at 76.22 trillion yuan, up 6.4% year on year, 1.3 percentage points higher than the growth rate of all loans, and financial support for the development of the service sector has achieved notable results. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 中国央行官员：加强财政金融协同，进一步降低服务业融资成本
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行信贷市场司副司车士义29日在新闻发布会上表示，加强财政金融协同，通过再贷款和财政贴息政策叠加，进一步降低服务业融资成本。今年上半年，地方法人金融机构新发放中小微民营企业贷款加权平均利率较去年同期下降了0.4个百分点。（新华财经）

headlines.title_en: PBOC official: Strengthen fiscal-financial coordination to further lower financing costs for the service industry
headlines.summary_en: Che Shiyi, deputy director of the PBOC's Credit Market Department, said at a press conference on the 29th that fiscal and financial coordination will be strengthened, and through the combination of relending and fiscal interest subsidy policies, the financing cost for the service sector will be further reduced. In the first half of this year, the weighted average interest rate on new medium, small and micro private enterprise loans issued by local legal-person financial institutions fell 0.4 percentage points from the same period last year. (Xinhua Finance)

headlines.summary_zh:
全球房地产公司仲量联行（JLL）表示，已看到中国大陆写字楼和零售物业市场初步复苏迹象的国际投资者，预计将在供应过剩担忧缓解后开始买入。

headlines.title_en: CCPIT: Global trade friction index remained at a high level in July
headlines.summary_en: The China Council for the Promotion of International Trade released the latest Global Economic and Trade Friction Index, with data showing that the index remained at a high level in July. From the composite index, the Global Economic and Trade Friction Index in July 2026 was 101, at a high level. The amount involved in global economic and trade friction measures fell 18.7% year on year and 2.2% month on month, mainly because the US, EU, India and others密集 introduced import and export tariff measures in the same period last year, pushing up the index; 68 trade remedy investigations were launched globally in June this year, while in July it fell back to 17. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: In the first eight months of this year, China's total social logistics value reached 243.6 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year on year
headlines.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing released logistics operation data for January-August this year. In January-August, the total national social logistics value was 243.6 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year on year. The steady growth of total social logistics value advanced in tandem with structural optimization, further highlighting the resilience of industrial and supply chains. Specifically, the basic plate of industrial goods logistics was stable, with total industrial goods logistics value up 5.3% year on year in January-August, and demand for upgraded industrial manufacturing logistics accelerated. In August, value added in high-tech manufacturing and digital product manufacturing grew 16.7% and 15.7% respectively, contributing more than 60% to above-scale industrial growth, while industrial robot output rose 34.6%, jointly driving new logistics demand.

headlines.title_en: Research Report Nuggets丨Haitong International: Cuts Laopu Gold target price to HK$435, rating "Outperform"
headlines.summary_en: Haitong International issued a report lowering its target price for Laopu Gold (6181.HK) by 21% to HK$435, maintaining an 'outperform' rating. The firm estimates the company's 2026-2028 revenue at 32.255/30.263/32.896 billion yuan, changing 18.1%/-6.2%/8.7% year on year; adjusted net profit at 6.823/6.443/7.127 billion yuan; adjusted net margin at 3.16%/5%/10.106%/5.6%. Considering the high base, weak consumption environment and operational uncertainty brought by gold price volatility, it lowered the target price but maintained the rating.
